verdict.rationale: Runway's pricing page lists 'Music, voice & sound effects generation', and the platform describes itself as generating video, images and audio in one workspace, so creators can generate audio in the same tool as their video. No evidence shows the audio is generated to match a specific scene (e.g., video-to-audio sync), and only a pricing-line mention documents it. Missing for 10: documented scene-matched/video-conditioned audio generation, ambient audio specifics, in-depth docs, hands-on corroboration.
